name: Gamepad API and haptics
plain: Reads buttons and sticks of a connected game controller; can trigger rumble.
meaning: Shows that a controller exists and exactly how it is being used. Controller id strings leak make and model.

access.prompt_ui: No prompt; the controller must be used (button press) before the page can see it

safari.note: Vibration only on macOS 16.4; Vision Pro connect events fire without press

data.update: poll per animation frame (60 Hz typical)

fields.name: id
fields.precision: for example vendor and product id plus name; fingerprint bit source

limits.headline: Can see your game controller after you press a button, and make it rumble
limits.user_action: You press any button on a connected controller while the page is open.
can: See which buttons you press and how far you move the sticks
Tell which controller is connected, once you use it
cannot: See the controller before you press a button
See controllers when the page is in a hidden tab in most cases
Keep going after you close the page
Work fully in Safari or Firefox, where rumble is limited
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge fully support it. Safari and Firefox support parts, with rumble often missing.

story.what_it_is: A page can read your game controller's buttons and make it rumble.

marketing.name: Gamepad API
marketing.pitch: MDN says it lets pages read game controllers' buttons and sticks, and make them vibrate.

story.for_you: You plug in or connect a controller, press a button, and the page notices it. Your controller can shake when your car hits a wall.
story.for_makers: Makers can build console style games in a tab. It is key for cloud gaming, where the browser sends your button presses to a faraway console or PC.

use_cases.example: Xbox Cloud Gaming in the browser reads your Xbox controller and sends your moves to the cloud.
A browser racing game rumbles your controller when you scrape a wall.
A streaming site lets you move through menus with a controller on a TV.
A page lets someone with limited mobility use a special controller.
A coding class teaches kids to write games that use controllers.
A site can tell which controllers are connected, which adds to a fingerprint.

technical_bounds: Needs a button press before first exposure
Only the focused page sees gamepads
Android Chrome limited to connected gamepads

history.change: Gamepad API ships; connected events in 25
